concepts.label: Popover + chip
concepts.position: Grant in a small popover (scope buttons, until chips or a typed time) opened from the row's right-click or the ⋯ menu; a live grant is a chip with time left on the row's name line, and clicking the chip revokes it (Undo toast)

concepts.label: Menu + its own line
concepts.position: Grant straight from a 'Monitor other tabs' submenu on the row's right-click (and ⋯): pick what it answers, then a duration, no dialog; a live grant gets its own line under the row with a Revoke button that's always there

concepts.label: Palette + status line
concepts.position: Grant from ⌘K by typing like the CLI ('monitor 2am', 'monitor 8h prompts'); a live grant reads on the row's second line (eye + time left) with Revoke on hover there, and a pill in the tab's own header while it's on screen
